This ZIP archive includes the correspondence table between the Central Product Classification (CPC) Version 2.1 and the International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), Rev.4.

This file has been produced by the United Nations Statistics Division.


Initial publication: 19.08.2015

Update History:
- 19.08.2015	** The correspondence does not yet include divisions 61 and 62 of the CPC. These will be added later.
